one_sentence_promise: Turn operational intent into validated, reusable automation.
customer_problem: Teams spend excessive specialist time authoring and testing repeatable automation.
current_workflow: Requirement; manual authoring; lab setup; testing; repair; approval; deployment
problem_evidence: Hypothesis to validate through design-partner time studies.
customer_outcome: Reduce time to a validated automation artifact and increase reuse.
behavior_change: Manual author-test-debug loops to guided generation, validation, approval, and reuse.
value_proposition: Prove automation before customers depend on it.
north_star: Validated artifacts moved into operational use
solution: A guided service for intent intake, generation, representative validation, evidence, approval, and export or execution.
availability_now: Prototype workflow for scripts on supported test targets.
near_term: Stabilize validation and recruit design partners.
medium_term: Add artifact types and portfolio entry points after evidence gates.
beyond: Broaden integrations only after customer and commercial proof.
right_to_win: Domain expertise, validation, governance, and operational integration.
out_of_scope: Autonomous production change; unsupported endpoints; unvalidated financial claims
portfolio_leverage: Shared capability exposed through existing product experiences.
dependencies: Identity, entitlement, execution support, billing, and governance readiness.
operating_model: Product owns jobs and evidence; Engineering reliability; Security boundaries; GTM proof; Finance economics.
growth_mechanism: Usage-led expansion, product adoption, and retention.
buying_committee: Infrastructure leader; automation champion; engineer user; security and architecture approvers.
pricing_hypothesis: Included activation capacity followed by annual usage packs; validate after first successful outcome.
financial_scenarios: No committed forecast. Model low, base, and high only after reachable-cohort validation.
phase_gates: Trust; customer value; commercial proof; governance readiness.
pilot_plan: Use a focused design-partner cohort with before and after time studies.
risks: Commoditization: differentiate on validation; trust: approvals and evidence; cost: meter usage; over-positioning: phase-based availability.
governance: Least privilege, approval, audit, scoped credentials, supported-target matrix.
recommendation: APPROVE a stage-gated pilot and scale only after trust, repeat use, and economic proof.
validate_next: Time saved; validation success; trust threshold; repeat usage; willingness to pay; unit economics.
status: Business initiative - executive proposal / planning assumptions
